articles.title: Chattogram Port Paralyzed as Workers Strike Over Foreign Takeover of Key Terminal
articles.mainIdea: Chattogram Port Paralyzed as Workers Strike Over Foreign Takeover of Key Terminal
articles.summary: Sourcing Journal: Chattogram Port Paralyzed as Workers Strike Over Foreign Takeover of Key Terminal. Dockworkers are protesting a proposed lease of the New Mooring Container Terminal to DP World, halting cargo movements in and out of the port.

articles.title: California Regional MLS Offers Tuesday, a New App That Turns the MLS into a Social Feed
articles.mainIdea: California Regional MLS Offers Tuesday, a New App That Turns the MLS into a Social Feed
articles.summary: PR Newswire: California Regional MLS Offers Tuesday, a New App That Turns the MLS into a Social Feed. California Regional MLS (CRMLS), the most recognized multiple listing service in the nation, has entered a new agreement to offer Tuesday, the MLS app that helps connect agents and properties, at no additional cost via the CRMLS Marketplace.

articles.title: Carriers say military to secure Red Sea voyages
articles.mainIdea: Carriers say military to secure Red Sea voyages
articles.summary: FreightWaves: Carriers say military to secure Red Sea voyages. One of the biggest ocean container shipping partnerships said it will return to the Red Sea-Suez Canal trade route with help from naval forces.
